about: Vectors for the x402/exact/polkadot/lcp-assets-remark pairing of @integraledger/lcp's polkadot entry point. H is SHA-256("abc"). V1 is a real extrinsic read live (block 21,053,708, index 3); V2's call was printed by @polkadot/api 16.5.6 and equals a hand encoding in Python; V3's extrinsic was accepted by TaggedTransactionQueue_validate_transaction on Polkadot Asset Hub (Invalid(Payment): signature and extensions accepted, the account unfunded); every BLAKE2b-256 is b2sum -l 256 (GNU coreutils 9.4). The eraNonce rows' signer, era and nonce are as @polkadot/types 17.0.1 decodes them under Polkadot Asset Hub's transaction extensions (eraNonce's about). Reader fixtures take Sidecar's answer shapes; heights are decimal strings. The upper-case remark rows replace the 77 remark bytes of V3 and V2's call with lcp:sha256:0x and H's digits in upper case; the signature is V3's and does not cover those bytes, which bound does not verify. The recover and status rows with another call put it after V3's signed preamble and extensions, SCALE by hand with each call's pallet and call index as Polkadot Asset Hub's runtime has them (polkadot-fellows/runtimes at 30696143, system-parachains/asset-hubs/asset-hub-polkadot/src/lib.rs:1731-1776: System 0, Balances 10, Utility 40, Proxy 42, Assets 50, ForeignAssets 53; polkadot-sdk at 23b84ba4: utility batch 0, batch_all 2, force_batch 4, proxy.proxy 0, balances transfer_keep_alive 3, assets transfer_keep_alive 9), and recompute the length prefix; the signature is V3's and does not cover that call, which neither recover nor status verifies. The re-signed status rows replace V3's signature with 64 bytes of 0x11, and one its era bytes a502 with b502. A status row's events with another call are constructed in Sidecar's shape, each as the pallet emits it (pallet_proxy's ProxyExecuted, pallet_utility's BatchInterrupted, ItemFailed, ItemCompleted and BatchCompletedWithErrors, pallet_balances' Transfer, the assets pallet's Transferred under foreignAssets). Status rows are read with the act payment at the finality the row gives, finalized where it gives none, after the position the row gives, by the signer's account nonce as the profile's rule 8 states it: the reader fixture answers V4's raw extrinsics at block 100 and one bare v4 item (length, 0x04, a two-byte call) at every other height from 90 to 120, the row's finalized and head heights, the account nonce at each, and the chain's validation of the presented extrinsic (valid at the height given, or not valid); these answers are constructed, not recorded. Each expected answer is derived by hand from read-status.md and the profile's rule 8; each transfer of what moved is named by the extrinsic's timepoint and its place, the index of its event among the fixture's events as the endpoint lists them.

V1.case: a real rail vector: extrinsicHash, splitSigned's signer, and bound with the last 43 bytes as call

V3.case: complete(V3), bound, reference, and the refusals

refusals.case: a 77-byte remark that is not LCP
a remark whose hash digits are upper case
refusals.source: profile rule 3: R is the 77 ASCII bytes lcp:sha256: followed by H, and rule 1 writes H as 0x lowercase hex; frame_system's remark_with_event emits Remarked with hash = BlakeTwo256 of the remark's bytes as signed, so an upper-case remark's event never carries the hash of H's LCP string

refusals.case: V3 resized to 4,097 bytes, one over the 4,096-byte bound
refusals.source: V3 resized: V3's signed preamble and V2's call, with zero bytes added before the call where the extensions sit, under a SCALE Compact<u32> length prefix in its two-byte mode, ((n << 2) | 1) little-endian for n from 64 to 16,383; built in Python 3

refusals.case: V3 resized to 4,097 bytes in upper-case hex: an extrinsic that is not lowercase hex is malformed before it is sized
refusals.source: V3 resized: V3's signed preamble and V2's call, with zero bytes added before the call where the extensions sit, under a SCALE Compact<u32> length prefix in its two-byte mode, ((n << 2) | 1) little-endian for n from 64 to 16,383; built in Python 3

V4.case: the remark hash; status and recover on reader fixtures

status.case: the signer's extrinsic at the signed nonce, found by the search at block 100, finalized: settled, the payment presented
the same with the finalized height 99: at the head, below the mark asked
the same with the finality head asked: settled at the head
success false: the extrinsic carries the remark and did not dispatch, so it consumed the nonce: transaction-failed once the search to the head is whole
no Remarked event: the remark's call did not run, transaction-failed, naming what its events show it moved
a Transferred of asset 1984 to the payee: settled, what moved recorded as observed and compared with nothing
the record at block 100, index 2 has another hash than the raw extrinsic's: the search holds at that block
the timepoint a settler named, at the position given: before-position
the nonce at finalized past the signed one and the extrinsic not in the range read: search-incomplete
validation answered valid at 50: the era (64, 42) ends at block 105; finalized 110, the nonce not past the signed one, and the search to the head whole and empty: instrument-unused
the same with finalized 104: the era not yet ended at finalized, the signed extrinsic can still land: instrument-live
no validation answered valid: no bound is proven and the lapse is never answered: instrument-live
a reader error
a block of the range at or below finalized that the endpoint does not hold: history-gap
proxy.proxy over the profile call, its inner call failed: ProxyExecuted carries the error and no Remarked, the nonce consumed: transaction-failed
utility.batch of the transfer and the remark, the transfer failing first: BatchInterrupted at 0 and no Remarked, the signed transfer naming payTo: transaction-failed
utility.batch with the remark first and the transfer failing after it: Remarked, nothing moved, settled on the act agreement
the same on the act payment: nothing moved names payTo, instrument-consumed, other-account
utility.force_batch of the transfer and the remark, the transfer failing: Remarked, nothing moved, settled on the act agreement
the same on the act payment: nothing moved names payTo, instrument-consumed, other-account
batch_all of balances.transfer_keep_alive to the payee and the remark: a balances.Transfer to payTo, settled, the native token recorded as observed
batch_all of a foreignAssets transfer to the payee and the remark: a foreignAssets Transferred to payTo, settled, its asset recorded as observed
a re-signed copy at the signed nonce, its signature another and its signed body the presented one's: settled, presented yes
a copy re-signed at the signed nonce with another era: settled, presented no
batch_all of the two calls in the other order, the remark first: settled, the transfer's event at its own place
a block whose first items are bare, a v4 and a v5 item each over POLKADOT_BOUNDS.extrinsic: the search passes them and settles on the signer's extrinsic

recoverRefusals.case: the raw extrinsic at the timepoint carries an upper-case remark
recoverRefusals.source: profile rule 3: R is the 77 ASCII bytes lcp:sha256: followed by H, and rule 1 writes H as 0x lowercase hex; frame_system's remark_with_event emits Remarked with hash = BlakeTwo256 of the remark's bytes as signed, so an upper-case remark's event never carries the hash of H's LCP string; the record's hash is the raw bytes' BLAKE2b-256, so the bytes are the extrinsic's

recoverReads.case: finalized 99: the block is above the finalized height, and recover reads it as found
recoverReads.source: Sidecar: /blocks/head/header answers the most recently finalized block; a block above it is read as found, as the status row with finalized 99 reads it (settled at head)

recoverReads.case: the canonical block at 100 is another block holding the same extrinsic at index 2: its record is read
recoverReads.source: Polkadot SDK: an extrinsic is identified by its block and index; the same signed bytes at index 2 of the canonical block at 100 are the payment there, as the status row of this fixture reads it

recoverReads.case: the canonical block at 100 holds another extrinsic at index 2: the named block is off the finalized chain
recoverReads.source: Polkadot SDK: once a block is finalized it can never be reverted, so a block at a finalized height other than the canonical one is not on the chain, and the timepoint names no extrinsic there; status finds the signer's extrinsic by its account nonce, never by the timepoint, which is a hint

recoverReads.case: the canonical block at 100 has nothing at index 2
the block's extrinsics hold no entry at index 2
recoverReads.source: Sidecar: /blocks/{block}/extrinsics-raw answers every extrinsic of the block, and a block hash names one block, so a list with no entry at the index shows the timepoint names no extrinsic on any later read

recoverReads.case: Transferred of asset 1984 at the named position: no transfer of the call's asset
recoverReads.source: the plant's record: an event of another asset is not the transfer of asset 1337 that the call names Since the pairing's success is the extrinsic's dispatch with Remarked for the remark, whatever it moved (the profile's rule 8, Succeeded), recover returns H whatever the extrinsic transferred.

recoverReads.case: Transferred of asset 1984 at the named position, finalized 99: the block is above the finalized height
recoverReads.source: Sidecar: /blocks/head/header answers the most recently finalized block; a block above it can be replaced (GRANDPA finalizes blocks; until then a fork can replace one), so its record gives no verdict yet, as the status rows with finalized 99 read it (at head) Since the pairing's success is the extrinsic's dispatch with Remarked for the remark, whatever it moved (the profile's rule 8, Succeeded), recover returns H whatever the extrinsic transferred.

recoverReads.case: success false: the extrinsic did not dispatch
recoverReads.source: Sidecar's extrinsic record: success false is a dispatch that failed, in which batch_all applies neither call, so no Remarked event is emitted; the block is at the finalized height, as the status row success false reads it (failed at finalized)

recoverReads.case: success false, finalized 99: the block is above the finalized height
recoverReads.source: as the row Transferred of asset 1984 at the named position, finalized 99; the status row success false, finalized 99 is failed at head

recoverReads.case: a utility.batch of the remark and a system.remark whose data is the profile call: it ends with the profile call and moves nothing
recoverReads.source: pallet_utility's batch (call_index 0) of frame_system's remark_with_event (7) and remark (0), whose data is V2's call, around V3's signed preamble, SCALE by hand; frame_system's remark emits no event and moves nothing, so the record has Remarked and no Transferred; the hash is b2sum -l 256 Since the pairing's success is the extrinsic's dispatch with Remarked for the remark, whatever it moved (the profile's rule 8, Succeeded), recover returns H whatever the extrinsic transferred.

recoverReads.case: the raw extrinsic at the timepoint is a bare system.remark_with_event of the remark, with no transfer
recoverReads.source: profile rule 3: the call is exactly utility.batch_all([assets.transfer_keep_alive(asset, Id(payTo), amount), system.remark_with_event(R)]); the call is frame_system's remark_with_event (call_index 7) around V3's signed preamble, SCALE by hand; the hash is b2sum -l 256

recoverReads.case: the raw extrinsic at the timepoint is a utility.force_batch of the transfer and the remark
recoverReads.source: profile rule 3, as above; pallet_utility's force_batch (call_index 4) carries on after a call fails, where batch_all applies both calls or neither; V2's call with its call index changed from 2 to 4; the hash is b2sum -l 256

plant.case: the record at block 100 holds no Remarked event: never settled

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairings, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. Where the ATR is abc, H is its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1) and the planted ATR is abd. SHA-256 values are GNU coreutils sha256sum, which openssl dgst -sha256 matches. Bytes are hex. A B2 input names the account, the buyer's inputs and the time (now, in seconds) its build needs. noSignedPayment names each pairing of the file that has no B6 row, and why.

rows.name: B6
rows.note: presented is this file's V3 payment, as the file holds it; no signature was made for this row.

boundAccepted.case: The file's payment presented under options this pairing's read does not offer, each the payment's own option changed as the row's case names, or another pairing's option: bound holds the presented accepted to the option filter read applies and refuses each with the row's code, the code advertise gives that option (x402/option-not-this-pairing for an option that is not this pairing's). payment is a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into this file.

rows.case: the option with maxTimeoutSeconds 0, outside 1 to 3600
the option with amount "abc", which is not a decimal amount

eraNonce.about: The era and the account nonce that follow the signature, the first two explicit bytes of the extensions (CheckMortality, then CheckNonce), each row's expected value as @polkadot/types 17.0.1 decodes it: its ExtrinsicSignatureV4 read from the byte after the version byte, under a TypeRegistry whose signed extensions are Polkadot Asset Hub's, in the runtime's order (polkadot-fellows/runtimes at 30696143, system-parachains/asset-hubs/asset-hub-polkadot/src/lib.rs:1835-1851, the TxExtensionV0 a signed v4 extrinsic carries, its identifiers listed at :3136-3148), AuthorizeCall, EthSetOrigin and StorageWeightReclaim given no explicit bytes (each encodes none there: SetOrigin's one field is codec(skip), polkadot-sdk substrate/frame/revive/src/evm/tx_extension.rs:48-53 at 23b84ba4). That decoding gives the signer, the era, the nonce and the call that follows the extensions, `call`, which it must end exactly at. A mortal era's two bytes are as polkadot-sdk substrate/primitives/runtime/src/generic/era.rs:118-135 at 23b84ba4 decodes them: period 2 << (e mod 16), phase (e >> 4) times max(period >> 12, 1); one zero byte is immortal. V3 was accepted by the chain's TaggedTransactionQueue_validate_transaction on Polkadot Asset Hub, so its extensions decode under the runtime; V1 is a real extrinsic read live, whose call is not the profile's. The other rows are constructed: V3's bytes (or V1's signed preamble and extensions) with the explicit extension bytes written by hand in SCALE in Python 3.12.3, V2's call after them and the length prefix recomputed; the signature does not cover them, which reference does not verify. reference reads each row whose call is V2's to the same signer, era and nonce.
